sentences.japanese: 教会は森と湖に囲まれている。
sentences.english: The church is surrounded by woods and lakes.

sentences.japanese: 丘のふもとに美しい湖がある。
sentences.english: At the foot of the hill is a beautiful lake.

sentences.japanese: 危ういところで少女は湖でおぼれそうになった。
sentences.english: It was a close call when the little girl almost drowned in the lake.

sentences.japanese: 角を曲がると、湖が見えてきた。
sentences.english: As we went around the corner, the lake came in sight.

sentences.japanese: 我々は湖の近くでキャンプをした。
sentences.english: We made camp near the lake.
